question: The value of frac{{tan 45^circ - tan 30^circ }}{{1 + tan 45^circ tan 30^circ }} is:
solution:
**Given: **

frac{{tan 45^circ - tan 30^circ }}{{1 + tan 45^circ tan 30^circ }}

**Concept used:**

tan 30° = (1)/(√3)

tan 45° = 1

(a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b² 

(a² - b²) = (a - b)(a + b)

**Calculation:**

frac{{tan 45^circ - tan 30^circ }}{{1 + tan 45^circ tan 30^circ }}

⇒ ([1 - (frac{1)/(sqrt 3))]}{[1 + 1((1)/(sqrt 3))]}

⇒ ([frac{(√ 3 - 1))/(√ 3)]}{[((√ 3 + 1))/(√ 3)]}

⇒ ((sqrt 3 - 1))/((sqrt 3 + 1)) ...[multiplying (sqrt 3 - 1) to both numerator and denominator]

⇒ ([(sqrt 3 - 1)(sqrt 3 - 1)])/([(sqrt 3 - 1)(sqrt 3 + 1)])

⇒ ([(sqrt 3 - 1)²])/([(sqrt 3)² - (1)²] )

⇒ ([3 - 2(√3)1 + 1])/([3 - 1])

⇒ ((4 - 2√3))/(2)

⇒ (2(2 - sqrt 3))/(2) = (2 - sqrt 3) 

**∴ The value of the given equation is (2 - sqrt 3).**
